changelog.name: v1.6.0
changelog.body:
## 🚀 What's New

- 🎨 **UI Refresh:** Updated and polished the user interface for a cleaner, smoother experience.
- ⚡ **libxposed API 102:** Upgraded the module to support the latest `libxposed` API 102.
- 📖 **In-App Help Guides:** Added dedicated help sections inside **My Parameters**, **Unwrap Redirect Links**, and **Excluded Websites** for easier configuration.

## 🚀 تغییرات جدید

- 🎨 **به‌روزرسانی رابط کاربری (UI):** بازطراحی و بهبود ظاهر برنامه برای تجربه‌ای روان‌تر و تمیزتر.
- ⚡ **ارتقا به libxposed API 102:** به‌روزرسانی ماژول برای پشتیبانی از جدیدترین نسخه `libxposed` API 102.
- 📖 **راهنمای درون‌برنامه‌ای:** اضافه شدن بخش راهنمای اختصاصی به قسمت‌های **پارامترهای من**، **باز کردن لینک‌های ریدایرکت** و **سایت‌های استثنا** برای تنظیمات راحت‌تر.

changelog.name: v1.5.0
changelog.body:
### ✨ What's New
* ⚡ **Quick Settings Tile:** Added a GhostShare QS Tile to quickly toggle the Quick Restore Notification on or off directly from the notification panel.
* 🔄 **Custom Parameter Updates:** Added an update option to fetch and update tracking parameters from any custom source.
* 🔗 **Test a Link:** Paste any URL to preview and see the exact tracking parameters that get removed.
* 🔀 **Redirect Rules:** Manage patterns used to extract and find the real destination inside wrapper links.
* ⚙️ **My Parameters:** View, add, or remove custom tracking parameters from your cleaning list.
* 🌐 **Site Rules:** Set custom rules to keep or remove specific parameters for individual websites.
* 🛡️ **Excluded Websites:** Add domains to a whitelist so links from those websites are never modified.

### 🛠️ Improvements & Fixes
* 🎨 **UI Optimization:** Improved the user interface for a smoother and cleaner experience.
* 🔒 **Security & Bug Fixes:** Fixed existing bugs and optimized overall app security and stability.

changelog.name: v1.4.0
changelog.body:
### What's Changed 🚀

**⚙️Advanced Settings**
App Scope & Filtering:
Selected Apps Only: Clean URLs copied strictly from selected apps while leaving others untouched.
Bypass Mode: Exclude selected apps from URL cleaning while protecting everything else.
Resolve Redirects:
Automatically unwrap intermediate tracking/redirect links (e.g., [google.com/url](https://google.com/url), l.facebook.com) to their original destination.

**🎯 Parameters & Exceptions**
Custom Parameters: View, add, or delete tracking parameters manually.
Domain Whitelist: Exclude specific websites so their links are never modified.

**💾 Backup & Restore**
Export to JSON: Back up all custom parameters and whitelisted domains to a single file.
Import from JSON: Easily restore or load your rules and exceptions from a backup file.

readme:
👻 GhostShare
System-level privacy shield that strips tracking parameters from copied links in real-time.

--- **✨ Overview** **GhostShare** is an ultra-lightweight, battery-friendly LSPosed module hooked directly into `system_server`. It automatically monitors clipboard operations and cleans telemetry, affiliate, and analytical tracking tags from URLs without breaking essential parameters or requiring root background services. **🚀 Key Features** * **Zero Overhead ($O(N)$ fast-path):** Bypasses non-URL clips instantly; zero battery drain. * **Deep System Hook:** Runs securely inside `system_server` with zero memory leaks (`ThreadLocal` sanitation). * **Silent & Non-intrusive:** 5-second silent notification with an instant **Undo** button. * **Preserves Media States:** Retains crucial parameters like YouTube timestamps (`t=`, `start=`) and playlist indexes. * **Material You (Dynamic Colors):** Follows system palette, dark/light themes, and edge-to-edge aesthetics. * **Per-app settings:** *Enable per-app* cleans links only for the apps you choose, *Bypass Mode* never touches links copied from the apps you choose. * **My Parameters:** the tracking-parameter list is data, not code. See, add and remove parameters (a trailing `*` matches a prefix) or restore the defaults. * **Excluded websites:** links from the websites you add (subdomains included) are never changed. * **Update lists:** an update button in My Parameters and Excluded websites fetches the latest lists from GhostShare, AdGuard and ClearURLs, or from a link you add yourself (parameters you removed stay removed). Sources can be reordered, and the order is remembered. The network is used only when you tap a source. * **Site rules:** per-website rules to always keep or additionally remove specific parameters (for example keep `t` on one site, or remove `foo` on another). Rules cover the site and its subdomains, and a keep rule always wins. * **Link test:** paste a link inside the app to see the cleaned result and exactly which parameters were removed, using your current settings. * **Quick Settings tile:** add the Quick Restore Notification tile to your Quick Settings panel to turn the 5-second restore notification on or off without opening the app. * **JSON backup:** export and import your parameters and exceptions through the system file picker, with overwrite or merge on import. * **Redirect links:** unwraps wrapper links (`l.facebook.com`, `google.com/url`, `youtube.com/redirect`, `out.reddit.com`, ...) to the real destination. * **Live changes:** every change is applied immediately, no reboot needed (after the first reboot that loads the updated module). **🌐 Supported Platforms** * **Instagram:** every query parameter is removed, except the functional ones (`img_index`, `story_media_id`, `next`, `q`) * **YouTube & YouTube Music:** `si`, `feature`, timestamp preserved * **X (Twitter):** `s`, `t`, `ref_src` * **TikTok & Google Analytics:** `_r`, `_t`, `gclid`, `fbclid` * **Reddit & Pinterest** * **Spotify & SoundCloud** **📥 Installation** 1. Install [LSPosed Framework](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed). 2. Download and install the latest `GhostShare.apk` from [Releases](https://github.com/BS1388/GhostShare/releases). 3. Enable **GhostShare** in LSPosed Manager (Target: `System Framework` / `system_server`). 4. Reboot your phone or soft-restart the framework. --- **📄 License** Copyright (C) 2026 [BS1388](https://github.com/BS1388). readmeZh:
👻 GhostShare
系统级隐私保护，可实时从复制的链接中删除跟踪参数。

--- **✨ 概述** **GhostShare** 是一个超轻量级、电池友好的 LSPosed 模块，直接连接到“system_server”。它自动监控剪贴板操作并清除 URL 中的遥测、附属和分析跟踪标签，而无需破坏基本参数或需要根后台服务。 **🚀 主要特点** * **零开销（$O(N)$ 快速路径）：** 立即绕过非 URL 剪辑；零电池消耗。 * **深层系统挂钩：** 在“system_server”内安全运行，内存泄漏为零（“ThreadLocal”卫生）。 * **静音且非侵入性：** 5 秒静音通知，带有即时 **撤消** 按钮。 * **保留媒体状态：** 保留 YouTube 时间戳（`t=`、`start=`）和播放列表索引等关键参数。 * **Material You（动态颜色）：** 遵循系统调色板、深色/浅色主题和边缘到边缘的美学。 * **每个应用程序设置：** *启用每个应用程序* 仅清理您选择的应用程序的链接，*旁路模式* 永远不会触及从您选择的应用程序复制的链接。 * **我的参数：** 跟踪参数列表是数据，而不是代码。查看、添加和删除参数（结尾的“*”与前缀匹配）或恢复默认值。 * **排除的网站：** 您添加的网站（包括子域）的链接永远不会更改。 * **更新列表：** 我的参数和排除网站中的更新按钮可从 GhostShare、AdGuard 和 ClearURLs 或您自己添加的链接获取最新列表（您删除的参数将保持删除状态）。源可以重新排序，并且顺序会被记住。仅当您点击来源时才会使用网络。 * **站点规则：** 每个网站的规则始终保留或另外删除特定参数（例如，在一个网站上保留“t”，或在另一个网站上删除“foo”）。规则涵盖站点及其子域，并且保留规则始终获胜。 * **链接测试：** 在应用程序内粘贴链接，以使用您当前的设置查看清理结果以及确切删除的参数。 * **“快速设置”磁贴：** 将“快速恢复通知”磁贴添加到“快速设置”面板，以在不打开应用程序的情况下打开或关闭 5 秒恢复通知。 * **JSON 备份：** 通过系统文件选择器导出和导入您的参数和异常，并在导入时覆盖或合并。 * **重定向链接：** 将包装链接（`l.facebook.com`、`google.com/url`、`youtube.com/redirect`、`out.reddit.com`、...）解开到真正的目的地。 * **实时更改：** 每个更改都会立即应用，无需重新启动（在加载更新模块的第一次重新启动后）。 **🌐支持的平台** * **Instagram：** 除功能参数外，每个查询参数都被删除（`img_index`、`story_media_id`、`next`、`q`） * **YouTube 和 YouTube 音乐：** `si`、`feature`、保留时间戳 * **X（推特）：** `s`、`t`、`ref_src` * **TikTok 和 Google Analytics：** `_r`、`_t`、`gclid`、`fbclid` * **Reddit 和 Pinterest** * **Spotify 和 SoundCloud** **📥 安装** 1.安装[LSPosed框架](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)。 2. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/BS1388/GhostShare/releases) 下载并安装最新的 `GhostShare.apk`。 3. 在 LSPod Manager 中启用 **GhostShare**（目标：`System Framework` / `system_server`）。 4.重新启动手机或软启动框架。 --- **📄 许可证** 版权所有 (C) 2026 [BS1388](https://github.com/BS1388)。根据 GNU GPLv3 许可。 --- 由 [BS1388](https://github.com/BS1388) 开发
